explication: Gonum is a broad Go numerical and scientific-computing library, not a single end-user application. Users call package APIs to perform numerical operations and receive results in memory. Its major capability areas include linear algebra, graph algorithms, statistics and optimization, signal processing and integration, spatial and interpolation tools, and foundational numerical utilities. The graph groups these product domains and shows only selected cross-package calls visible in the supplied excerpts or SOURCE INDEX; many package relationships are intentionally omitted because their implementation was not sampled.
